seo.title: Smart JSA Bridge Singapore | Risk Assessment & JSA
seo.description: Prepare task risk assessments, reuse JSA content and organise work document packages. English workspace for Singapore users.

header.subtitle: Configure document headers and the permit-to-work information needed for your task.

hero.seoText1: Browse the shared English hazard and control library as a starting point for your assessment. These entries are general references, not a Singapore-specific regulatory dataset. Check each suggestion against the actual task and applicable local requirements.

hero.subTitle1: A practical workflow for preparing and reviewing task risk assessments
hero.subTitle2: alongside your workplace's Singapore WSH procedures.

hero.subTitle: Use this planning guide alongside Ministry of Manpower (MOM) guidance and the Workplace Safety and Health (Risk Management) Regulations. A completed form alone does not establish compliance.

section1.para: Internal risk assessment procedures describe how a workplace identifies hazards, evaluates risks and puts controls into practice. MOM's guidance covers routine and non-routine activities and recommends a multidisciplinary assessment team.

infoList.item4: Keep an accessible record of the assessment, decisions, controls and review actions.

section2.title: 2. Suggested Structure for Internal Procedures
section2.para: The following ten headings are a practical drafting checklist, not a prescribed statutory form. Adapt them to the work and the applicable requirements.

item9.content: Define where assessments and control records are kept, who maintains them and the applicable retention period. The Risk Management Regulations require the relevant records to be kept for at least three years.

row1.col2: Plan the assessment and controls before the activity begins, including preparation and non-routine work.
row1.col3: Include the people who understand and perform the task.

row2.col2: Review at least once every three years, and sooner when changes or incidents trigger a review.
row2.col3: Do not wait for the scheduled date if the assessment is inadequate.

row3.col2: Review after significant process or design changes, new machinery, substances or procedures, or an injury or incident from hazard exposure.
row3.col3: Recheck the controls and communicate the revised assessment.

section4.title: 4. Official Sources and Workplace Review
section4.para: Check current official guidance and the requirements for your activity before approving work. This editor does not certify a site, assessment or permit.

legalList.item1: MOM: Risk management — assessment, control and communication guidance.
legalList.item2: MOM: When to review an assessment — scheduled and change-triggered reviews.
legalList.item3: Singapore Statutes Online: WSH (Risk Management) Regulations — current legal text.

hero.subTitle1: Select protection for the hazards and exposure of the actual task.
hero.subTitle2: Check fit, compatibility, training and maintenance, together with
hero.subTitle3: applicable Singapore WSH requirements and the manufacturer's instructions.

item1.desc: Select a helmet for the expected impact and any electrical hazards; check its limitations.

item4.desc: Select respiratory protection for the substance and exposure. Filtering respirators do not supply oxygen and cannot protect in an oxygen-deficient atmosphere.

item1.q: Where can I find Singapore workplace safety guidance?
item1.a: Start with MOM's workplace safety and health guidance and the WSH Council's resources. Check the requirements relevant to your activity and equipment.

item2.q: Does a certification mark guarantee that PPE suits the task?
item2.a: No. Check the protection offered, test documentation, size, fit and compatibility with other equipment against the actual hazards.

item3.a: Follow the manufacturer's service-life and replacement instructions. Check condition before use and remove damaged or unsuitable equipment from service.

item4.a: Keep the product identification, instructions, relevant test or conformity information, and your workplace's inspection and training records.

ui.subTitle1: Identify hazards, evaluate risk and choose suitable controls
ui.subTitle2: using your workplace's assessment method and applicable Singapore requirements.

tasks.c: Work where a fall could cause injury. Assess access, edges, openings and fall prevention for the actual task.
Entry involving restricted access and possible hazardous atmospheres; plan isolation, testing, ventilation and rescue.
Welding, cutting or other tasks producing heat, sparks or flame.
Plan the load, lifting equipment, ground conditions, exclusion zones and communication.
Assess electrical hazards and establish suitable isolation and verification before work.
Check ground stability, buried services, access and nearby plant before disturbing the ground.
Specialist work with radiation sources requiring task-specific controls and authorisation.
Assess the substance, exposure routes and safe handling using current safety data.
Control hazardous energy and verify the safe condition before maintenance.

section7.content: Users must assess content against the laws and requirements applicable to their workplace. Selecting Singapore or using an example does not certify compliance with Singapore WSH requirements.
